# cvp_workspace_submit (Action)

Submit the workspace, creating change controls (REQUEST_SUBMIT; set force=true for REQUEST_SUBMIT_FORCE).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Submit a workspace, creating change controls. Set force = true to submit
# despite build warnings (REQUEST_SUBMIT_FORCE).
action "cvp_workspace_submit" "example" {
  config {
    workspace_id = cvp_workspace.example.workspace_id
    force        = false
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `workspace_id` (String) The `workspace_id` of the target workspace.

### Optional

- `force` (Boolean) Submit even if the workspace has build warnings (REQUEST_SUBMIT_FORCE). Defaults to false.
